description.value: Dookbaeki is a Korean soul food restaurant specializing in traditional stone bowl dishes — the eponymous dookbaeki — along with slow-cooked soups and stews simmered for up to 48 hours to develop deep flavour and nutrition. The Coquitlam location is part of a small chain with Edmonton outposts, situated near Coquitlam Centre mall. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect hearty, bone-broth-based meals like seolleong-tang and a variety of soontubu soft tofu soups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Coquitlam location at 3055 Anson Ave with postal code V3B 2H6 and provides a phone number (604) 474-0707 not present in OSM tags. The site prominently features online ordering ('Online Order Now') with a 10% discount, confirming takeout availability. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Dookbaeki is a legitimate, active restaurant serving substantial meals well-suited to hungry cyclists, but no evidence exists in website content or OSM tags for any of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms). Inclusion should wait until at least one required criterion can be confirmed via on-site visit or direct contact.
